title: Describe the CLI recursion guard as refusing an inherited verification context, not a SpecSync-made child
description: Describe the CLI recursion guard as refusing an inherited verification context, not a SpecSync-made child
acceptance_criteria: SHIP-1.c.1: REQ-cli-003 says the dispatcher refuses a check, change or lifecycle command that runs under an inherited SPECSYNC_VERIFICATION_CONTEXT and cites REQ-change-023 for SpecSync setting that marker on no child of its own; the cli spec Purpose, the cli.3md context plane and the docs/HLD.md failure-mode row no longer describe a SpecSync-made verification child.
SHIP-1.c.2: cli_contracts_describe_an_inherited_verification_context_not_a_child fails on main and passes after the change.

Runtime behavior is unchanged: no file under src/ changes, and indirect_recursive_lifecycle_check_fails_once_with_context and indirect_recursive_lifecycle_subcommands_fail_once_with_context still pass unmodified.

answers.constraints: change.3md lesson: a successor that contradicts its predecessor does not retire it, someone has to; this change retires the cli predecessors. Leif's decision (d) on #848: the dead runner stays, only its contracts are qualified. No runtime change. Strictness stays: no gate, bound, timeout or existing assertion is loosened.
